title: Opening night: Android ships from main, the pipeline page is up, and six things only you can do
headline: Since 15:20: /pipeline/ traces two features from your voice to release (messaging 1 h 40 min, the web app 1 h 35 min). Android: conductors promote on security's signed pass, PR #2 merged, a full Play dry run green at v0.1.125, the HIGH fixed in code. The news app on the web installs offline. Indi's team's iOS work reaches TestFlight from dev; security reviews its latest stages now; nobody yet holds the iOS slot. The rota runs on four conductors. What remains needs your hands or your word.

for_you.ask: GitHub, Apple and Google, in your hands
for_you.detail: Android: main as default branch, Environment promote limited to main, the Play credential. iOS: the team as internal TestFlight testers. OpenRouter: the top-up dev.verify@ waits on.
for_you.recommend: Internal testers tonight: Indi's team builds every hour.

for_you.ask: The iOS conductor, your word in its session
for_you.detail: conductor@ios.PrompTugal.dinis (account B): yes to its 'Shall I?', take the :00 slot, read briefs/.
Android asks you to confirm it in its session; it lets the pipeline view connect every commit to your voice brief.
